name: wafermap
description: Give your agent an x402 wallet with spending caps: find and pay Wafermap's pay-per-call resources (LLMs, image and audio models, web reading, on-chain data, tokenized stocks, prediction markets) and third-party x402 services, with a receipt and a transaction for every payment. The key and the caps stay on your machine.
